spans.text: **Best Practice:** When you see token usage exceed 80%, you should consider manually triggering compression (by typing `/compact`) rather than waiting for auto-compression to trigger. Proactive compression typically preserves more valuable content because you can provide advance guidance on which information is most important.
spans.note: The prompt actively promotes user agency by encouraging proactive compression over reactive compression, giving users control through manual /compact commands with custom preservation hints, and providing transparent warnings at multiple threshold levels so users can make informed decisions.
